notes.title: 🌿 Now available on iPad 🌱
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ockUHQ45xwk;full][/previewyoutube]

Five Years Old Memories is now available for the iPad!
Some of the interactions are different from those of the Mac/PC version and offer a sensory experience unique to tablets. Like touching a picture with your finger...
If you have an iPad, please check it out🙌

App Store(iPad)▶https://apps.apple.com/app/five-years-old-memories/id1643670905

* Excluding some countries and regions(EU and mainland China)
